name: In Good Taste
summary: Marin Noggenfogger finds thistleshrub dew awful to drink, yet he keeps working on the brew. He sends you to Sprinkle in Gadgetzan with the dew.

sections.title: A Cook for a Bad Brew
sections.body: Marin Noggenfogger tastes the dew and finds it awful. Still, he keeps working on the drink. He sends you to Sprinkle, his friend in Gadgetzan and an excellent chef. You carry the dew and explain that the drink needs to go down more easily. Marin also wants it to have some kick.

faq.q: Where does this step fit in the chain?
aliases: what is next in the chain
faq.answer: It follows The Thirsty Goblin, and Sprinkle's Secret Ingredient comes next.

faq.q: Why does Marin Noggenfogger want the dew taken to Sprinkle?
aliases: what does marin want with sprinkle
faq.answer: Marin Noggenfogger finds the dew awful to drink. He hopes Sprinkle, whom he calls an excellent chef, can make it go down more easily and give it some kick.
Sprinkle is in Gadgetzan, the same town as Marin Noggenfogger.
